description:
Fantom Corporation is seeking an RF Software Engineer Level 1 to develop and implement digital signal processing (DSP) algorithms for signals of interest. This position focuses on high-throughput signal exploitation, processing signals with low signal-to-noise ratios, and supporting higher-order or adaptive modulations.
Clearance: Fully cleared before starting, with a polygraph completed within the last seven years

Key Responsibilities
 

 
 Design and implement DSP algorithms in software for high-throughput signal exploitation.



 
 Develop signal processing capabilities for low signal-to-noise environments and higher-order or adaptive modulations.



 
 Modify existing software and firmware to adapt commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and government off-the-shelf (GOTS) products to meet specialized government requirements.



 
 Develop software using C++, Python, or similar programming languages within Linux environments.



 
 Provide clear, concise explanations of developed models and algorithms so team members can understand and use them to process signals of interest.






Required Qualifications

 Must be fully cleared with a recent MD polygraph 

 Must be willing and able to work fully onsite at the location listed in this posting 


 

 
 Four years of experience as a DSP algorithm developer on projects using similar software processes, subject to the education substitutions below.



 
 Four years of experience with C++, Linux, Python, or similar development technologies.



 
 Demonstrated experience with Linux.



 
 Formal training in, or demonstrated proficiency with, C++ and Linux.



 
 Must be fully cleared before starting, with a polygraph completed within the last seven years.






Education
 

 
 Bachelor of Science in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline from an accredited college or university.



 
 Four additional years of DSP experience may substitute for the bachelor’s degree.



 
 A Master of Science in Engineering or Computer Science may substitute for two years of the required experience.




 #CJ



Fantom Corp is a Software Development, Agile Cloud, Cyber Security (Risk Management, Assessments & Authorization (A&A)), Data, AI Platform (Computer Vision Models), Podcasting Media Services, and IT Services provider. Established in 2015, Fantom Corp serves Federal customers with top-notch Cybersecurity Architects, Data Scientists/Analysts, Software Engineers/Developers, DevSecOps Engineers, Project Managers, Identity, Credential Access Management (ICAM) services , and Cloud-certified practitioners. We excel in delivering emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) with a focus on identifying trends, object detection, and classification of structured and unstructured data. Fantom Corp possesses mastery in all aspects of digital audio production. We lead in the ideation and creation of efforts for clients who want to harness the power of podcasting. We guide them in selecting the right show format for their needs and goals. As a Small Business, we possess the innovation, speed and flexibility to meet your requirements.
